observations: Implement-phase change-analysis attempted populate_versioned_graph for the parent revision (e61c709eb): reached 29,675 SymbolVersion nodes before stalling; the after revision (bccb17514) was never reached.

Root cause: the SUPERSEDES edge step in populate_versioned_graph is O(N^2) at full-repo scale. Its Cypher is MATCH (old:SymbolVersion) WHERE old.entity_id = $ent AND old.version_id <> $vid — a per-symbol label scan. The only entity_id index is on :Knowledge(entity_id); no :SymbolVersion(entity_id) index exists, so each of ~30k symbols scans every SymbolVersion node.

Consequence: the first run_workflow.py invocation died during graph population (empty log = SIGKILL, no Python traceback) after ~25 min of a single revision. The graph leg is impractical at this scale; the cell was re-run delta-only (--change-analysis WITHOUT --change-analysis-graph) with --resume to complete the measurement.
